extracted.intended_audience: early-career cancer researchers applying for Damon Runyon postdoctoral fellowships and their prospective Sponsors/mentors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and selection criteria for Damon Runyon Postdoctoral Research Fellowship applicants (including Level 1 and Level 2/physician-scientist tracks) and their Sponsors, describing eligibility, evaluation criteria, and post-award expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of the Research Proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Importance of the problem; Originality of approach; Appropriateness of techniques; Clarity of presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary criterion used to evaluate applicants — reviewers assess whether the proposal addresses an important problem, uses an original approach, employs appropriate techniques, and is clearly presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualifications, Experience, and Productivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualifications, experience, and productivity of both the candidate and the Sponsor; strong publication record; track record of research excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators consider the candidate's and Sponsor's prior accomplishments and productivity (including publications) and overall demonstration of research excellence when assessing suitability for the fellowship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of the Research Training Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the proposed research will be conducted; potential for broadening and strengthening the candidate's ability to independently conduct innovative and substantive research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether the proposed lab/institution provides a training environment conducive to developing the candidate's independence and substantive research skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — Level 1 (Basic and Physician-Scientists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Received degrees no more than 18 months prior to application deadline; must not have been in their Sponsors' labs for more than one year prior to application deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are hard eligibility requirements for Level 1 applicants; failure to meet them disqualifies the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — Level 2 (Physician-Scientists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant holds MD, MD/Ph.D., DDS, DVM, DO, or equivalent; completed residencies and clinical training; board-eligible in the United States at the start of the Damon Runyon Fellowship; devote at least 80% of their time to Damon Runyon-supported research activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Level 2/physician-scientist applicants must meet clinical training and board-eligibility conditions and commit the required fraction of effort to research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must hold a tenured, tenure-track or equivalent position; be capable of providing mentorship to the Fellow; and have a track record of mentoring postdoctoral researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sponsor eligibility and demonstrated mentorship experience are evaluated to ensure appropriate guidance and training for the Fellow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novel Research Direction Required
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed research and training environment should represent a new opportunity for the candidate to expand their scientific skill set; direct extensions of the candidate's graduate work (in approach, technique or exact area of study) will NOT be funded; encourages mobility between labs and institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals that are direct continuations of graduate work are explicitly ineligible; reviewers favor projects that broaden skills and demonstrate mobility and new directions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continued Funding Contingent on Progress
rubrics_metrics.description: Second-, third- and fourth-year funding contingent upon satisfactory progress reports; annual progress reports required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ongoing support is conditional — awardees must submit annual reports and demonstrate satisfactory progress to receive subsequent years' funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantitative Biology Fellowship Emphasis
rubrics_metrics.description: For postdocs with quantitative training (math, physics, computer science, engineering) applying quantitative skills to cancer research; same selection criteria with quantitative emphasis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants to this specialized fellowship are evaluated using the same overall criteria but with particular attention to the application of quantitative skills to cancer problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancer Research Relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong emphasis on cancer research relevance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals are expected to be directly relevant to cancer research; relevance to cancer is a core program priority and factor in selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence and Mobility Encouraged
rubrics_metrics.description: Independence and mobility are encouraged as features of the program and implicit evaluation considerations (e.g., new training environments, moving between labs/institutions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers favor candidates and proposals that demonstrate potential for independence and that take advantage of mobility to broaden skills and networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection Process and Review Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications reviewed by a scientific committee; external reviewers consulted for some applications; committee deliberation and final selection; announcement typically 4-6 months after submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the review workflow (internal committee review, possible external reviews, committee deliberation) and typical notification timeline; helps applicants understand evaluation stages and timing.
